IndexFact.invariants: Finite index value; no guessed conversion or unit. Month is YYYY-MM, year 0001..9999.

ScorecardFact.invariants: Supplier-level fact; missing metric remains null. PPM is a count per million, not a percent.

CostFact.invariants: cost_base is the two-uppercase-letter source country code (e.g. DE), matching V1 should-cost data; null is unknown. confidence_pct is source uncertainty half-width percent, not calibrated probability. unit_cost is the declared priced basis.

QuoteFact.invariants: Nonempty unique part_ids equal the set in price.basis; unique typed observed term fields; validity is source timing, not standing-offer eligibility.

ContractFact.invariants: Nonempty unique parts. clause_refs name immutable evidence revisions containing clause text, not unverified commercial bindings.

ForecastFact.invariants: Quantity may be fractional; change_pct is signed percentage points, finite with lower bound -100. Null is unknown, never zero.

OrderPriceFact.invariants: Quantity may be fractional; part must occur in price.basis.part_ids.

TextRecord.invariants: document_kind/declared_role are open nonempty source labels. Unknown labels convey no authority. Empty text is valid; preserve formulas and malformed statements verbatim.

NamedEstimate.invariants: Registered names are closed: full_cost/extra_per_unit use EUR_per_price_unit and require basis; full_cost >0; rates use fraction >=0; ppm uses ppm >=0. Both bounds or neither, low<=value<=high, same numeric domain. extra_per_unit is signed.

EstimateRecord.invariants: Unique names, nonempty values. Registry v1 allows all NamedEstimate names for these methods; adding methods/names requires a contract revision. Explicit fixture method never implies calibrated uncertainty. Nonempty assumptions citing input facts or explicit documented assumption records.

EvidenceRecord.invariants: EstimateRecord payload requires estimate/hypothesis kind. Supplier statement cannot use estimate payload. No self supersession; canonical_id may be absent for statements; scorecards cannot carry part-level/basket scope.

FileDigest.invariants: Relative POSIX path; reject absolute, empty, dot/dotdot segments, backslash/NUL. Symlink safety is checked by the data adapter, not inferred from a string.

SourceManifest.invariants: Unique file paths; empty files legal for explicit synthetic source; content_hash verified against consumed bytes by adapter.

ScopeIndex.invariants: Unique record IDs; resolve existence when assembled into PreparedEvidence.

PreparedEvidence.invariants: Unique record IDs/parser names/index (kind,key). Index refs exist. integrity_hash = semantic_hash of JSON excluding prepared_at, integrity_hash, artifact_id; verified by codec, not guessed by DTO. artifact_id is sha256:<integrity_hash>. All preparation hash verification is codec-owned; DTO enforces formats and internal index references only.

Conflict.invariants: At least two unique candidates; winner if supplied belongs to candidates; unresolved blocking conflicts have no winner.

RelevanceRecord.invariants: Rank is retrieval policy only; never authority.

EvidenceContext.invariants: Unique record identities; relevance refs exist; conflicts may also reference shadowed input records retained in preparation. Context builder derives version from meaningful evidence/case inputs; no DTO winner selection.

ResolvedCostInput.invariants: Nonempty source_refs; same record revisions as internal claim projection.

PartIdentity.invariants: part_id is included in explicitly declared price_basis.part_ids.

TermOption.invariants: Nonempty unique values; validate each by TermBinding(field,value). unit price need not have an option row; verified-standard permission conveys no certificate.

MustHave.invariants: TermBinding validation. Ordered comparisons only numeric/date fields; incoterm/index_clause allow ==/!= only.

FreightRate.invariants: Finite EUR per declared physical unit; no implicit divisor.

IndexPath.invariants: Finite forecast change fraction >=-1; signed, not a probability.

AvailableAlternative.invariants: Nonempty provenance; complete terms contain unit_price. Operational alternative is distinct from fallback scoring.

UnavailableAlternative.invariants: No numeric infinity or zero-cost synthetic alternative.

FieldOrigin.invariants: Nonempty source_refs for every field including case-derived buyer defaults.

ResolvedTerms.invariants: Unique bindings; exactly one origin for each field, same field set. origins is the frozen §8.1 spelling, not field_origins. Hash derived by resolver over sorted bindings/origins.

ResolvedStandards.invariants: Unique bindings; exactly one origin per field. This model retains field_origins from §2. Quote overrides master; resolution is service-owned.

BuyerEconomics.invariants: Same price basis for current/fallback. Cost/risk penalties nonnegative, signed cost components remain legal elsewhere. Freight has exactly EXW/FCA/DAP once each; unique series. Horizon/need may be fractional; preserve official convention.

CaseContract.invariants: Nonempty unique suppliers/parts/negotiable fields; unique option/fixed fields; fixed and negotiable disjoint; options subset negotiable; basis parts declared by case. Schema preserves official case types; executable capability preflight remains restricted to approved slice. contract_hash verified by adapter over full JSON excluding contract_hash/title/refs, with field-sorted terms/options; raw official bytes separate. Schema checks only digest format; the official adapter recomputes the contract hash before construction. No DTO calls kit arithmetic. refs preserves official declared record/document IDs; resolved source revisions belong to evidence/projection SourceRefs.

SupplierStandards.invariants: Tuple element for EconomicContext.standards_by_supplier; unique supplier keys in parent, no mutable map.

SupplierEstimate.invariants: All prices same basis; low<=full_cost<=high; nonempty assumption_refs. Coincident bounds legal for explicit fixture point estimate with unknown uncertainty, never calibrated automatically.

EstimateScenario.invariants: Nonempty unique estimate IDs; at most one per supplier after EconomicContext resolves IDs. No weights or invented probabilities.

ScenarioPolicy.invariants: Disabled: both tuples empty. Nominal: exactly one scenario. Robust: >=1 scenarios. Non-disabled has nonempty unique required suppliers; every scenario covers each required supplier exactly once. Coverage belongs to EconomicContext validator.

CostPolicy.invariants: Tick must be 0.01 in contract v1. Ceiling nonnegative if supplied. Price interval is case-bound, no invented default max.

EconomicContext.invariants: Unique standards supplier keys (case members); unique estimate IDs and case supplier/basis joins. Scenario refs resolve; mandatory required suppliers covered in every scenario. Robust comparison iff robust mode. Disabled has no estimates. Hash checked by builder over economic inputs including source revisions; never greeting prose.

CostComponent.invariants: Official 11 component names only; signed finite payment/index components allowed.

ScenarioCost.invariants: Unique components. If components supplied, cent-rounded sum equals cost; finite signed margin, no inferred acceptance probability.

PackageEvaluation.invariants: Valid numeric result requires nominal_cost and exactly 11 unique components with half-even cent sum parity. Invalid numeric result requires null cost, empty components/scenarios and nonfinite_cost error. basis_verified/must_haves do not imply approval.

OfficialCostResult.invariants: Exactly 11 unique component kinds; finite cent-rounded sum parity.

StrategyIntent.invariants: Clarify requires question_id; other kinds omit question_id. Exchange has dimension and non-unchanged direction with observation/evidence refs. Keep has unchanged direction. request_close has unchanged direction; evidence_challenge requires evidence_refs. rationale is internal text only.

OfferAction.invariants: 1..3 unique package fingerprints; <=3 unique claim IDs. Packages remain negotiated contents, not resolved fixed terms.

QuestionAction.invariants: At most 3 unique claim IDs; default claim_ids=(). No package/cost authority.

CandidateAction.invariants: Candidate ID is semantic hash of contract/snapshot/intent/target/contents, checked by generator/engine. No transport or model-authored action.

GenerationResult.invariants: Unique candidates for this intent. Empty candidates requires error infeasible/unsupported_capability issue. All candidate.intent_id match intent_id.

IntentBatch.invariants: Unique intent IDs; all intent snapshots match.

EvaluatedCandidate.invariants: Offer has one evaluation per package with matching fingerprints; non-offers have none. Approved offers all numerically_valid/basis_verified/must_haves_ok and no error issue. Rejected requires error issue.

EvaluationBatch.invariants: Unique candidate/evaluation IDs; every candidate snapshot matches; registered batch hash verified by evaluator/engine over sorted items.

NegotiationDecision.invariants: Selection certificate refers to an approved registered batch member; DTO shape alone grants no execution capability. decision_id uses UUID per universal ID rule; existing schema-only DecisionRecord unchanged.

ObservedSheet.invariants: Unique parseable bindings, outside-option values preserved. Malformed fields absent from bindings and described in issues/raw artifact. Standing alone grants no acceptance eligibility.

DocumentRecord.invariants: Partial/unsupported/failed require issues. Raw bytes remain separate; formulas preserved as attributed source text.

ClaimCheckResult.invariants: Index is response-local, not proof of claim identity or persuasion.

ConversationMessage.invariants: Empty body legal. Referenced message spans use same session/thread/message. Hash checked against stored raw source by gateway.

ConversationView.invariants: Unique scoped message IDs; every message belongs to session/thread. Full view v1, no truncation fields or silent truncation.

ClockEvidence.invariants: received>=requested; authoritative requires server_deadline_at or seconds_left; conservative requires conservative_deadline_at. Clock arithmetic belongs to budget service.

RoundEvidence.invariants: Counts do not exceed limit; remaining<=limit; authoritative requires server_rounds_used. Submission attempts distinct.

TerminalEvidence.invariants: §8.7 supersedes earlier §2 shape. Deal true requires offer/supplier; proof existence/content/session checked by store/projector, never by supplier text. Missing score is null.

ServerThread.invariants: Conversation thread ID matches. Agreed is not session terminal; adapter rejects unsupported server statuses rather than guessing. walked_away/no_bid are official thread closure values; never rewrite to session ended.

ServerState.invariants: Unique thread/supplier IDs, conversation session matches. ended iff terminal present and matching session. Official state exclusively gateway observations.

ClaimCandidate.invariants: Nonempty source refs. Proposed canonical_sentence remains untrusted and recomputed by verifier. No verification certificate.

VerifiedClaim.invariants: Nonempty source refs. Only verifier issues; disclosure/recipient and numeric provenance independently checked at final validation.

Accept.invariants: Current standing offer and complete legal/economic evaluation checked by closing service.

WalkAway.invariants: Supplier recipient explicit; no cost fabricated for unknown economics.

AlternativeComparison.invariants: Executable kind requires alternative_ref; no_deal_score requires null ref. Operational fallback distinct from scoring cost.

CloseDecision.invariants: Accept requires evaluated_offer_refs; walk may have none. Issuer is closing service; model cannot invent binding recommendation.

AcceptPayload.invariants: Wire accept uses offer ID as term_sheet_id; no duplicate supplier field in message action.

WalkPayload.invariants: No extra numeric fields or invented terms.

OutboundAttachment.invariants: content_ref digest equals hash; bytes verified by adapter; classified approved attachments only.

MessagePayload.invariants: subject<=300/body<=8000 Unicode chars, packages<=3/refs<=20/attachments<=5; packages and action mutually exclusive; no action with packages. Empty packages/action legal question. Adapter maps Package.bindings to Arena term_sheets and preserves exact bytes.

RenderedAction.invariants: Exactly one decision_ref/close_ref; close ref iff accept/walk. Offer nonempty packages/no action; question empty packages/no action; accept/walk matching action type/no packages. <=3 unique claims. Hash verified by validator over full rendered JSON excluding render_hash.

ValidationReport.invariants: Unique check IDs; failure checks require error issues.

ValidatedAction.invariants: Matching snapshots; nonempty all-passed checks and no error issues; bytes ref digest matches payload_hash. Issued by validator; DTO does not grant execution.

DecisionBudget.invariants: model_call_limit<=2; fallback+submission<=compute limit. No ambient clock calls in DTO.

TransportBudget.invariants: Absolute deadline; attempts separate from server rounds.

PendingOperation.invariants: commit=source+1; digest matches bytes ref; endpoint matches kind. Open has no session/supplier/validation; send/close require all three. submitted_at>=created_at; submitted/acknowledged require submitted_at/attempt_count>=1; acknowledged/rejected require response_ref. Unknown open retains original ID/bytes. Null source/commit sessions are only the open case; status uncertain may have no submission timestamp when transport outcome is unknown.

DispatchPermit.invariants: Ownership/lease and current hash freshness verified by executor after queue; shape not capability provenance.

StrategyAttempt.invariants: acknowledged/rejected require response refs; proposed intent alone is no attempt.

RefusedExchange.invariants: Nonempty citations; package scope requires fingerprint, dimension scope requires dimension. Refusal remains inferred/reported evidence, never legal prohibition.

ClaimUsage.invariants: Unique canonical IDs; reservations managed atomically by store; same operation never consumes twice.

StrategyMemory.invariants: record_ref digest equals payload_hash; separately registered payload schema validated by owning strategy/store. No arbitrary payload field.

PackageChange.invariants: At least one before/after; binding fields equal field; if both present values differ. Null slot means missing field, while TermBinding(null) is explicit null.

ClaimAttribution.invariants: Nonempty citations; nullable claim ID when response index cannot be confidently mapped.

HypothesisSupport.invariants: Nonempty citations; source attribution, no causal learning.

FeedbackObservation.invariants: Nonempty response_refs; unique changed fields/question IDs. Observed sequence never means causal gain.

StrategicState.invariants: Append immutable histories. Assessment ID unique; attempt IDs unique; preserve earlier revisions independently of policy activation.

NegotiationState.invariants: Server null only before identified session; case/session operations match. At most one unresolved prepared/submitted/uncertain operation. ended requires ended server; awaiting requires unresolved operation; null server only ready/awaiting/recovery_required. Ended server requires ended runtime; strategic histories never override server status. No synthetic known-session IDs.

NegotiationContext.invariants: case IDs and contract hashes agree across snapshot/case/economic; evidence context version equals snapshot; target scopes consistent. Full private input never serialized verbatim into model request.

DecisionSnapshot.invariants: Known open/agreed session; state/context config/version/case/session agree; target is case member and conversation thread/supplier match.

HoldOutcome.invariants: Future admissibility/time budget checked by engine; no busy loop in DTO.

CannotDecideOutcome.invariants: Nonempty error issues; never a commercial terminal.

DocumentBytes.invariants: bytes_ref digest equals bytes_hash. Bytes stored in artifact port, not a live client.

ServerObservation.invariants: Nonempty equally sized raw refs/hashes with matching digests; parsed observations remain gateway-owned; document descriptors do not authorize execution.

GatewayRejection.invariants: HTTP status 400..599; nonempty error issues; must definitely_not_applied=true; unclear application uses GatewayUnknown.

GatewayUnknown.invariants: No invented server observation or terminal proof.

InterpretInput.invariants: Purpose-specific grounded input; only approved disclosed/relevant projection, no buyer private budget/economic context.

SelectionOption.invariants: Fixed approved batch projection; no model numeric edits.

SelectInput.invariants: Nonempty unique candidate/evaluation IDs. Model chooses one ID; no added candidates.

SimulateInput.invariants: Private hypothetical projection; cannot generate authoritative evidence/server events.

ModelRequest.invariants: task equals input.kind. No headers, endpoint credentials or provider secret.

ModelBudget.invariants: max_calls<=2; retry_limit integer zero, boolean false rejected.

ModelUsage.invariants: Cost nonnegative if present; absent usage is null, not inferred free. Tokens are strict integers, boolean values rejected.

ModelSuccess.invariants: Raw string may be malformed JSON. response_hash is SHA256 of exact UTF8 raw string (not semantic hash of parsed object). No automatic schema validation here.

ModelRefused.invariants: Nonempty error issues; no successful raw output or invented usage. Require at least one error issue with code model_invalid; retain other source diagnostics.

ModelInvalid.invariants: Nonempty error issues; no successful raw output or invented usage. Require at least one error issue with code model_invalid; retain other source diagnostics.

ModelTimeout.invariants: Nonempty error issues; no successful raw output or invented usage. Require at least one error issue with code model_timeout; retain other source diagnostics.

ModelCapacityUnavailable.invariants: Nonempty error issues; no successful raw output or invented usage. Require at least one error issue with code unsupported_capability; retain other source diagnostics.

ModelTransportFailure.invariants: Nonempty error issues; no successful raw output or invented usage. Require at least one error issue with code recovery_required; retain other source diagnostics.

SelectorResponse.invariants: Exactly these two commercial fields plus schema_version; membership/quote entailment validated by selector, not provider.

SessionObserved.invariants: Artifact ref resolves to canonical typed payload content; store verifies bytes/value match. Transition, proof authority and dedupe are projector/store responsibilities under §8.7, never this DTO.

MessageObserved.invariants: Artifact ref resolves to canonical typed payload content; store verifies bytes/value match. Transition, proof authority and dedupe are projector/store responsibilities under §8.7, never this DTO. Message/thread/round identities agree; rounds equals thread_state.rounds.

DocumentObserved.invariants: Artifact ref resolves to canonical typed payload content; store verifies bytes/value match. Transition, proof authority and dedupe are projector/store responsibilities under §8.7, never this DTO.

ClaimReleased.invariants: Artifact ref resolves to canonical typed payload content; store verifies bytes/value match. Transition, proof authority and dedupe are projector/store responsibilities under §8.7, never this DTO. Release proof required; never infer no-transmission from local exception.
